profile.headline: Information Freedom Fighter and obnoxiously Puerto Rican
profile.jobTitle: Software Developer and Information Freedom Fighter
profile.summary:
Open source software developer, spreadsheet nerd, mentor, process minimalist, digital archaeologist, and percussionist.

Specialities: Open source, Kubernetes, distributed systems, DevOps, virtualization, timpani, taiko
Languages: Golang, Python, C/C++, bits of many others

positions.title: Software Developer and Information Freedom Fighter
positions.description:
Container Orchestration and Storage SME for IBM Storage Fusion, focused on designing cloud-native orchestration of complex, distributed AI stacks and storage systems.

➤ SME on Fusion Workloads squad: accelerated large-scale workloads on Fusion HCI with Data Foundation
➤ Technical lead on Content Aware Storage (CAS) Config Squad: integrated new AI inference stacks, hardened API security (RBAC, mTLS), and retooled project automation to improve developer experience and reduce CI build time by over 60%
➤ Lead developer on Local Data Caching for CAS: Multi-layered orchestration of storage software and services to accelerate a standalone deployment of CAS with no inter-cluster dependencies.
positions.insights: Skills: Container Orchestration · Kubernetes · OpenShift · Bash · Python · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Data Ingestion · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Microservices · Go (Programming Language) · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Cross-team Collaboration · Global Cross-Functional Team Leadership · Figma (Software) · nv-ingest · Ceph · GPFS · CNSA · Open-Source Software · Agile Project Management · Scrum

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project lead for open-source software projects used in OpenShift Data Foundation.

  ➤ Architecture and design focused on clean APIs, smooth UX, and optimized resource consumption
  ➤ Scoping of work based on team availability and shifting timelines
  ➤ Leading collaboration across teams, roles, and organizations within Red Hat and with partner companies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering
positions.description: Software development for OpenShift Container Storage. Team lead for installation, orchestration, and uninstallation. Facilitated multiple product training sessions, overview presentations, and participated in strategy planning sessions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development for Red Hat Storage, integrating network file access protocols with GlusterFS. Later moved to Container Native Storage, orchestrating the installation and configuration of GlusterFS inside Kubernetes.

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
Open-source contributor to the Samba project ( https://www.samba.org/ ).

➤ Evaluating various development workflow tools. (e.g. code review, continuous integration)
➤ Development on distributed file system integration and CTDB. [ C, Python, BASH ]

positions.title: Package Maintainer
positions.description: One of a team of package maintainers for the various Samba-related packages.

positions.title: System Administrator and All-Around Geek
positions.description:
System administrator, Pythonista, technical writer, code archaeologist, and various other hats.

➤ Developed a terminal-based order management system. [ Python ]
➤ Co-authored authoritative protocol specifications [MS-CIFS] and [MS-SMB] for Microsoft.
➤ Read through Microsoft kernel and reverse engineered protocol behaviors. [ Docs, C ]
➤ Managed a wide variety of systems, including Linux servers and BSD firewalls.

projects.title: Local Data Caching for IBM Fusion Content Aware Storage (CAS)
projects.description:
https://github.com/IBM/storage-fusion/blob/master/CAS/local-data-caching/

This tool deploys a configuration of IBM Fusion services that enable local caching of data from remote S3 buckets for ingestion by CAS. This is achieved by setting up an IBM Storage Scale Container Native (formerly known as CNSA) local Scale cluster on OpenShift Container Platform using local Data Foundation (DF) RBD volumes as backing storage devices.

projects.title: gk-deploy
projects.description: Command-line tool for deploying containerized GlusterFS and heketi into a pre-existing Kubernetes cluster, which provides a hyper-converged persistent storage solution for Kubernetes applications.
